correctness.rationale: From actual RESULT.md at the verified frozen Git tree, the projection onto a_i^T e=0 maps any nonzero current error to alpha n_i. The next residual magnitudes are |alpha|s_ij; for p>0 the repeated row has exactly zero probability. Thus index transition P_ij=s_ij^p/d_i and stationary detailed balance d_i/(2Zp) are exact. Multipliers are c_ij, so the irreducible finite-chain additive strong law gives the a.s. exponent ell(p). Differentiating is covariance of log s with the strictly decreasing log sqrt(1-s²), proving strict monotonicity except constant angles. Pairwise edge weights concentrate at maximal s as p grows. At p=0 independently uniform sampling DOES allow repeats; stationarity produces 2/m² sum log c, while p->0+ produces 2/[m(m-1)] sum log c. Check m=2 periodicity allowed, nonzero error from generic e0, no orthogonal rows. Independent exact geometry and numerical exponent checks at 6 p values match, including factor 3/2 for m=3. Finite checks corroborate; full a.s. quantifier rests on Markov ergodic theorem.
